member.summary: Send a cycle command to the USB port.
member.remarks:
This function is not supported for linux environments.
The effect of this function is the same as disconnecting then reconnecting the device from USB. Possible use of this function is situations where a fatal error has occurred and it is difficult, or not possible, to recover without unplugging and replugging the USB cable. This function can also be used after re-programming the EEPROM to force the FTDI device to read the new EEPROM contents which would otherwise require a physical disconnect-reconnect. As the current session is not restored when the driver is reloaded, the application must be able to recover after calling this function.It is ithe responisbility of the application to close the handle after successfully calling FT_CyclePort.

For FT245R devices, valid values are FT_BIT_MODE_RESET, FT_BIT_MODE_ASYNC_BITBANG, FT_BIT_MODE_SYNC_BITBANG. member.name: M:OmicronLab.FtdiDevice.IFtdiDevice.CyclePort
member.summary: Send a cycle command to the USB port.
member.remarks: The effect of this function is the same as disconnecting then reconnecting the device from USB. Possible use of this function is situations where a fatal error has occurred and it is difficult, or not possible, to recover without unplugging and replugging the USB cable. This function can also be used after re-programming the EEPROM to force the FTDI device to read the new EEPROM contents which would otherwise require a physical disconnect-reconnect. As the current session is not restored when the driver is reloaded, the application must be able to recover after calling this function.It is the responsibility of the application to close the handle after successfully calling FT_CyclePort.
